question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.**

It is hard to draw clear lines of ______ (division) between work and leisure.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Demarcation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about drawing clear lines between work and leisure, which suggests the need for a word that means separation or distinction.
 
• **Division** means separating or splitting into parts. (भागों में अलग करना या विभाजित करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *The division of labour in a factory assigns specific tasks to different workers.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Demarcation** means the act of setting boundaries or limits. (सीमा निर्धारित करने की क्रिया या भाव)
 
 
• **Example**: *The demarcation of property lines ensures clear ownership and prevents disputes.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'demarcation' is the most appropriate synonym for 'division' in this sentence.

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comprehension **means understanding. (समझ)
 
• **Administration** means management. (संचालन)
 
• **Procrastination **means delaying or postponing. (विलंब करना या स्थगित करना)
